general.description: As its name states, Lone Star (or Solitaire) is a lonely independante PurrSphere Station, located in a system on the crossroad of the Independants Stars, 13-planets league and Ka'Ralt Secession. On only one jump of Corridor, it sometimes gives shelter to runaway Adrimai on the raod to Freedom.
general.bar: Station's crew and runaway Adrimai having some reliefs in the Purring Hall of the living Station, happy to have some news vistors and maybe friends.
